--- title: "Code & Data Provenance" --- # Code & data provenance Every figure and table in this book is produced from the analysis code in [`tbep-tech/reasonable-assurance-analysis`](https://github.com/tbep-tech/reasonable-assurance-analysis). The table below maps each deliverable to its source. ::: {#tbl-provenance .cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
Deliverable Source Data object(s)
Fig 1 — Watershed LULC R/figs.R -> current land use figure data/lulc2023.RData, data/sgdat2024.RData, data/fluccslkup.RData
Fig 2 — Chlorophyll-a trends R/figs.R -> annual chl means all segments data/chldat.RData
Fig 6 — WBID attainment R/figs.R -> wbid attainments FDEP Nutrients_305b x RA watershed
Fig 7 — TN load by source tbep-tech/load-estimates (external) load-estimates outputs
Fig 8 — Per-capita TN R/figs.R -> tn lbs per year per person totanndat (load-estimates), data/popdat.RData
Fig 9 — Delivery ratios R/figs.R -> tn v hy all segs data/allsegdat8526.RData -> data/loadratios1985-2025.csv
Fig 10 — TN load vs. population tbep-tech/load-estimates (external) load-estimates outputs
Figs 3 & 4 — Seagrass R/figs.R -> seagrass coverage by bay segment SWFWMD Suncoast seagrass series
Table 1 — Loading sources tbep-tech/load-estimates (external) load-estimates outputs
Appendix 6 — Delivery ratios R/docs.R -> 2027 RA Update data/loadratios1985-2025.csv
Data assembly (all) R/dat_proc.R ACS/tidycensus, chlorophyll, LULC, seagrass
Shared functions R/funcs.R show_rathrplot(), raanlz_avedat(), dpsdiff_fun()
````` ::: ::: Figures 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, and 9 of the RA Update are generated in this repository; Figures 5, 7, 10, and 11 and the compliance / allocation tables are maintained in the RA Update document or the `load-estimates` pipeline. ## Pipeline order ``` R/dat_proc.R # assemble population, chlorophyll, LULC, seagrass, loading inputs -> data/ | +--> R/figs.R # Figures 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 9 -> figs/ ; writes data/loadratios1985-2025.csv | +--> R/docs.R # delivery-ratio table -> docs/loadratiotab1985-2025.docx ``` ## External dependencies - [`tbep-tech/load-estimates`](https://github.com/tbep-tech/load-estimates) — annual TN/TP/hydrologic load estimates; Figures 7 & 10 and Table 1 source data - [`tbeptools`](https://tbep-tech.github.io/tbeptools/) — thresholds, segment averaging, RA plotting helpers - US Census Bureau ACS (via `tidycensus`) — Tampa MSA population - SWFWMD — land use / land cover and seagrass coverage mapping - FDEP — 303(d)/305(b) impaired-waters assessment categories ::: {.provenance} Web companion to the 2027 Reasonable Assurance Update. Narrative text adapted from the 2027 RA Update document (2026 Q4 draft); figures and tables generated from [`tbep-tech/reasonable-assurance-analysis`](https://github.com/tbep-tech/reasonable-assurance-analysis). Several figures in the source document still carry drafting placeholders (e.g., the final 2026 baywide seagrass acreage reconciliation); these should be reconciled against the final signed submittal. :::
